# The modules under tests/ that write ROMP_SERVE_TOKEN at module level, one path per line relative to tests/, the floor
# modules aside; derived by the census of tests/test_hermetic_kernel_postal.py at round 2 of fork PR #894's review.
# The census pin compares it with the census by equality (_writer_set_faults): a module that writes the name and is
# not here faults as a new writer, and a module here that no longer writes it faults until its line is removed.
# Lines leave as writers migrate; a new writer is not added (omit the write or move it to the conftest floor),
# except as a rename of a line here.
